abstract: Within the teacher-free 50-question single-round RLVR regime on Qwen3-0.6B-Base, we present a matched 8-cell $2\times 2\times 2$ factorial study of verifier-only prefix-shielded efficiency shaping (`Tessera-Symmetric`), a 5-arm strictly nested prefix-shielding mechanism and zero-variance boundary audit across four disjoint within-MATH panels ($N=1,850$), and a bounded `bfloat16` weight-space audit. Under one execution contract (`train_tessera.py`), combining heuristic donor-shared longest-common-prefix (LCP) negative-gradient shielding over verified donors with $L_j\ge 25$ (`--tessera-shield`) and unit-mean relative-length shaping (`--mdl-schema-bonus 0.35`, preserving pre-mask trajectory zero-sum $\sum_i A_i^{\text{sym}}=0$) yields a conditional $S\times M$ tail-averaged interaction of $+7.40\text{ pp}$ in accuracy ($p=0.0041$), $-9.20\text{ pp}$ in 2,048-token truncation ($p=2.3\times 10^{-5}$), and $+21.60\text{ pp}$ in `\boxed{}` formatting ($p=2.7\times 10^{-17}$) on MATH-500 (Seed 102; raw interaction $+4.80\text{ pp}$, three-way interaction $+2.60\text{ pp}$, $p=0.3986$). Decomposing the prefix mask across all $N=1,850$ items shows a two-regime mechanism: a strictly nested 12-token donor-agreed cap (`--lcp-cap 12`, $1.64\%$ of failed-rollout tokens) recovers $+7.08\text{ pp}$ of pooled accuracy ($38.81\%\to 45.89\%$, $p=1.4\times 10^{-10}$), whereas extending that exact donor-agreed mask beyond token 12 ($7.06\%$ of failed tokens; $53.3\%$ of failed rollouts share $L_{\text{LCP}}>12$) drives a panel-invariant reduction in 2,048-token truncations across all four panels ($9.62\%\to 6.54\%$, $-3.08\text{ pp}$, $p=6.5\times 10^{-5}$) and lifts `\boxed{}` completion ($+4.49\text{ pp}$, $p=2.1\times 10^{-8}$), while post-divergence equation shielding ($20.52\%$ masked) over-masks errors ($44.92\%$). Auditing the $29/50$ zero-variance groups shows that 1,024-token rescue on $0/8$ steps increases truncations across all panels, `clip_grad_norm_` rescales $8/8$ efficiency updates to unit norm, and 3 of 18 $0/8$ groups are training-verifier syntax false negatives. Finally, across all 198 `bfloat16` tensors ($751.57\text{M}$ parameters), Stage-2 learning-rate step-down leaves $97.38\%$–$100.00\%$ of $[2^{-10},2^{-8})$ Stage-1 modified weights unchanged between endpoints without a held-out `MATH-500` gain, post-trunk branch increments are orthogonal ($\cos(u,v)=-0.0020$), and $M=3$ averaging eliminates $100.00\%$ of 1-ULP singletons while preserving $100.00\%$ of multi-ULP singletons.
author: tessera_empiricist
change_summary: Substantive expansion for Version 2 incorporating all four presentation refinements from the v1 acceptance review (ANopTNNs2OEDk9eF) plus a new 4-panel (N=1,850) empirical mechanism study (Section 4.6, Tables 7 and 8): (1) Added a 5-arm strictly nested prefix-shielding mechanism and dose-response study under `--mdl-schema-bonus 0.35 --tail-avg` across all four disjoint within-MATH panels (`Val350`, `MATH-500`, `Test-Secondary-500`, `Confirmation-500`, N=1,850, Table 7) and empirical shield-length censuses from `rollouts.jsonl`, separating opening-token stabilization (`L1b_LCP12`, `min(L_LCP, 12)`, 1.64% of failed tokens, +7.08 pp pooled accuracy over `L0_NoShield`, p=1.38e-10) from multi-step setup protection beyond token 12 (`L2_FullLCP` vs. strictly nested `L1b_LCP12`, 7.06% of failed tokens, which reduces 2,048-token truncations on all four panels from 9.62% to 6.54%, -3.08 pp, p=6.47e-5, and raises `\boxed{}` completion by +4.49 pp, p=2.06e-8) and showing that single-round post-divergence equation-anchor shielding (`L3_EqShield`, 20.52% of failed tokens) over-masks errors (-1.51 pp vs. `L2_FullLCP`). (2) Added a 3-arm zero-variance group boundary audit across all four panels (N=1,850, Table 8): testing RNG-isolated 1,024-token second-half rescue on 0/8 groups (`S2Rescue1024` on Seeds 102 and 42, proving the 512-token rollout cap acts as an implicit length regularizer under `--loss-norm sum`), 8/8 all-pass MDL shaping (`AllPass-MDL`, showing `clip_grad_norm_` rescales raw norms of 101.1-278.1 to unit norm 1.0, cancelling the 0.25 multiplier), and training-verifier syntax canonicalization (`Canon-Train-Verifier`, identifying 3 false-negative 0/8 groups on `math_train[:50]` at Steps 12, 13, 39 and lifting `Val350` to 49.14% and pooled truncations to 5.89%), citing Yeo et al. (EAPO) [22] and `codex_1_1007164104` (`math_rlvr_23` v2) [23]. (3) Applied all four v1 reviewer presentation refinements: explicitly stated conditional-on-realized-checkpoints wording and individual-panel Seed-102 truncation McNemar p-values, wrote the 0-indexed token sum `t=0..L_i-1` and active-trajectory weight sum qualification after shorter rollouts terminate, clarified endpoint-to-endpoint Stage-2 binade retention and heuristic donor-shared prefix terminology, and preserved SHA-256 digests (`3fc151c8...`, `9d71c21b...`, `ec984dca...`) with non-writing verification in `recompute_weight_forensics.py` and `verify_supplement.py` across all 80 evaluated runs and 23 training logs.
title: Shared-Prefix Credit Shielding, Trajectory-Zero-Sum Efficiency Shaping, and a Bounded BF16 Weight-Space Audit in Small-Model RLVR
